newsitem.title: USA: UPR says chances in Venezuela round slim.
newsitem.headline: UPR says chances in Venezuela round slim.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources said on Wednesday that its chances of winning a tender in the third Venzuelan oil licensing round were slim, but chief operating officer George Lindahl said that the company had been approached to work directly with the state oil company.
"PDVSA wants to negotiate directly with us for horizontal drilling technology," Lindahl told the Independent Petroleum Association of America conference here.
Venezuela's third licensing round will take place June 2-6 and twenty fields are on offer, but more than 130 international firms and 70 Venezuelans have qualified for the pre-tender stage.

Unoin Pacific already has operations in Venezuela with Benton Oil & Gas, but the main focus of its operations is in the U.S. and the company has a capital budget of more than $1.0 billion this year. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
